newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Wait-and-see mood pulls Bucharest bourse down.
newsitem.headline: Wait-and-see mood pulls Bucharest bourse down.

text.p: A wait-and-see attitude extended from last week depressed the average price of most Bucharest stocks, which also closed lower or flat on Monday.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, fell by 2.3 and respectively 2.08 percent from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index was 1.82 percent down at 2,844.81 points.
"Most stocks have released last year's results, investors have digested the news and obviously they are not contented and wait for fresh lows," said a trader.
Volumes thinned to 1.8 million shares from 2.3 million at the latest session last Friday, with turnover slipping to 5.7 billion lei from 7 billion.
Traders saw a recovery of the market later in the week.

The first tier dominated the session, accounting for 77 percent of turnover and trading a total 1.4 million shares. But all four listings in this section closed lower, due to the same investor attitude.
Oltchim chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures ended the session 50 lei weaker each at 2,350 and 2,450.
Pharmaceuticals companies Antibiotice and Terapia also fell, closing at 4,600 lei, or 200 lei lower, and respectively 6,250, shedding 50 lei.
The chemical sector was the most active on the second tier, with three stocks taking the bulk of volume and turnover.
Policolor dye maker put on a strong show, trading more than 178,000 shares on turnover of 949 million lei.
The second tier was otherwise dull, as six stocks had no trade and three were suspended pending release of 1996 results.
The VAB index is displayed on VANGUARD.
